bag_probe.title: Red Slouch Shoulder Bag
bag_probe.finding: Bag V2 drew the red shoulder bag well, but it made a new picture around it: a gallery background, a green dress in place of the white tee and jeans, and a new pose. Its documentation describes preset styles, chosen at random by default, and a fixed output size. That cannot show a shopper's own bag on them, and each bag would come with a different outfit, so the comparison would not be fair. The other three bags did not run, and Rechoice compares bags by their catalog details only.

gate: Switch shoes and bags on only if each result puts the product where it is worn or carried, keeps its colour and design, leaves the person otherwise unchanged, and delay and cost fit the owner-approved budget.
owner_decision: On 28 October 2026 the owner approved up to 16 units, a probe first for shoes and for bags, and their publication. The shoes passed and are published as recorded results; the bags probe failed its gate, so the other bags did not run and bag try-on is off. Per-result ratings are not yet recorded.

reading.by: Claude (AI assistant), 28 October 2026, before the owner's ratings
